_comment: The one list of Flux products. Edit here, then run npm run build:suite: it writes public/data/products.js (window.FluxProducts, loaded before flux-hub.js) and the static cards in suite.html. `group` places a product in Flux Suite; a group of kind "bar" is the wide bar on top (the planner), "tab" a pill tab over a grid. Order is display order. `blurb` is the Suite card's sentence; `tagline` the switcher's one line. A new product also needs a .app--<id> --c1/--c2 pair in public/css/flux-hub.css.

products.name: Flux Planner
products.blurb: Tasks, classes, your calendar and bell schedule, Plan my week, study tools, a reading log, college prep and Canvas assignments in one calm place. Sign in to sync across your devices.

products.note: Last, under Partner apps: built by Flux for another organization, so it follows Flux's own study apps rather than sitting among them. Its own brand rather than "Flux …": Synara keeps its name and violet look. A Flux Partner: built and hosted by Flux for another organization (partners.html). Its logo is the white pulse from public/synara/icons/icon.svg, filling a tile painted with the Suite's violet gradient (.app-icon--logo).

products.name: Aorta Project
products.tagline: Blood pressure and medicine tracker for families
products.blurb: From the Aorta Project: take your medicines, log your blood pressure and see right away if a number needs attention, for everyone in your family. Reminders show in your Flux Planner calendar, and it works offline.
